description: This file defines an enumeration 'AgentWorkspaceConfig' that provides static methods to get and set the 'workspace' configuration within a nested dictionary structure representing agent settings.

methods.name: workspace(from:)
methods.description: Retrieves the 'workspace' string value from the nested 'root' dictionary if it exists.

methods.name: setWorkspace(in:workspace:)
methods.description: Sets or removes the 'workspace' key within the nested 'root' dictionary, updating the 'agents' and 'defaults' dictionaries as needed.
